title: EventListing
description: A listing of all events and associated venue information in the TEG metaverse

id.description: A unique ID assigned to this event.

name.description: The name of the event assigned to this event.

description.description: A more verbose summary, describing the nature of the event; has been known to be hyped up :)

startDate.description: An ISO date that shows the event start date and time.

venueId.description: A reference ID that can be used to look up more venue information.

venues.description: A listing of venues that have events on

id.description: A unique ID assigned to this venue.

capacity.description: The number of patrons that this venue supports

location.description: A free text descriptor of the venue's location. These are not geo coordinates.
